Definition: from G3648; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, holoklēría means perfect soundness. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe holoklēría needs no more than its plain sense — perfect soundness.
